name: Alexej von Jawlensky
bio: Alexej Georgewitsch von Jawlensky, surname also spelt as Yavlensky, was a Russian expressionist painter active in Germany. He was a key member of the New Munich Artist's Association, Der Blaue Reiter group, and later Die Blaue Vier.

paintings.title: Medusa (Jawlensky)
paintings.story: Medusa or Head of a Woman "Medusa", Light and Shadow is a 1923 Expressionist painting by Russian painter Alexej von Jawlensky. It is held in the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Lyon, which acquired it in 1936. It is a work by the artist from the time when he began to focus on painting the human figure, in 1917.

paintings.title: Abstract Head
paintings.story: Abstract Head is an oil painting by Russian expressionist Alexej von Jawlensky, from c. 1921.
